### Fixed
- **The catalog's Anthropic ModelConfigs answer at the platform's output bound, not kagent's 8192** (giantswarm/agent-platform#702). A `kagent.modelConfigs[]` entry rendered no `maxTokens`, so an agent on one (gazelle's four Opus agents) stopped a long answer at kagent's built-in 8192 tokens, thinking included, while the default ModelConfig had the 32000 the platform manager sets. An Anthropic entry now inherits `kagent.providers.anthropic.config.maxTokens` like the cache keys; an entry's own `maxTokens` wins and lands in its provider's block (Anthropic, AnthropicVertexAI, AzureOpenAI, Mistral, OpenAI); on any other provider the render refuses it naming the entry. `make verify-max-tokens` asserts it.
